protocol.split: one deterministic lineage-grouped holdout per target
protocol.selection: test suggested_cv_fold maximizes minority-class test examples while requiring both classes in train and test; composite targets also retain every contributing label source on both sides
protocol.preprocessing: training-fold median imputation plus missing indicators for linear and randomized-tree models; native NaN routing for histogram boosting
protocol.warning: Exploratory engineering benchmark only; no independent clinical test set, patient-level prospective validation, or diagnostic claim.

targets.label: Artifact / degraded signal
targets.definition: BUT-QDB pure consensus class 1=0 and class 2/3=1, combined with NSTDB official noise-inactive=0 and noise-active=1.

targets.label: Ictal seizure interval
targets.definition: 1 only inside a configured original expert seizure interval; 0 outside.

targets.label: Non-normal beat
targets.definition: 0 for AAMI N and 1 for S, V, F, or Q; exact WFDB symbols remain preserved.

targets.label: NSTDB noise active
targets.definition: Official NSTDB alternating electrode-motion noise schedule.

targets.label: Strict unusable signal
targets.definition: Pure BUT-QDB consensus class 1 versus class 3; class 2 is excluded.

models.label: Regularized logistic regression
models.rationale: Interpretable linear baseline with balanced class weights.

models.label: Linear support-vector machine
models.rationale: Strong high-dimensional margin baseline with balanced class weights.

models.label: Random forest
models.rationale: Nonlinear interaction model robust to scaling and mixed feature behavior.

models.label: Extremely randomized trees
models.rationale: Tests whether stronger split randomization improves generalization and speed.
models.reference_title: Geurts, Ernst & Wehenkel, Extremely randomized trees (2006)

models.label: Histogram gradient boosting
models.rationale: Efficient nonlinear boosting for larger tabular matrices with native NaN routing.
